question: If I cast Lantern Flare for its cleave cost, do I choose the value of X?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: if you pay the cleave cost, you choose the value of X.
expected.answer: If you're paying the cleave cost, you choose the value of X.

whyHard: Without cleave, X is the number of creatures you control, so players expect it to stay that count.
